name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: As a miner, you can unearth raw minerals and make field gear such as a Lodestone to support your allies at camp.
As a cook, you can learn from cooking instructors to build the basic campfire at the heart of a wilderness campsite.
As a Horde miner traveling through Durotar, you can visit Krunn in Razor Hill to learn how to make Lodestones for your expeditions.

faq.answer: Skilled miners can seek Krunn in Razor Hill and learn to craft a Lodestone for a campsite.
Krunn trains skilled miners in Razor Hill, in Durotar. Once they show enough skill, he teaches them to make camp items such as the Lodestone.
Miners make Lodestones to place beside a wilderness campfire. Physical fighters gathered around it gain greater martial strength.
faq.q: What is a Lodestone used for?

aliases: why cant i camp in razor hill
faq.answer: No. Townsfolk and settlement authorities frown on camps in populated streets. Head into the surrounding wilderness to pitch camp and place your Lodestone.
faq.q: Can you set up camp inside Razor Hill?

faq.answer: A campfire forms the center of a working campsite. Cooking instructors teach you to build a basic fire, and cooking helps prepare you for camps in the wild.
faq.q: Why do you need a campfire before setting up camp?

faq.answer: Miners who show enough skill can learn to craft a Lodestone from Krunn in Razor Hill.
faq.q: Who can learn to craft a Lodestone?

sections.body: Mining yields materials for travel and survival in the wild. With skill in pick and ore, you can learn to make gear for a campsite. In Durotar, Krunn in Razor Hill teaches skilled miners to forge a Lodestone for their travels.
sections.title: The Miner's Camp

sections.body: At a wilderness camp, a Lodestone gives the gathered fighters greater strength in battle. Set it beside the campfire, and martial fighters around the flames gain an edge. Townsfolk frown on tents pitched in city squares, so you need the open wild to put your craft to use.
sections.title: Campfire Camaraderie

sections.body: A sturdy Lodestone needs a fire at the heart of camp. You need a basic campfire before setting up a resting place. If you do not know how to build one, seek a cooking instructor. Cooking teaches the basics for warmth and sustenance on expeditions beyond town walls.
sections.title: Fire and Fieldcraft

summary: In Durotar, skilled miners can learn to forge a Lodestone for camps in the wild. Krunn in Razor Hill teaches the craft.
